title: One pitch deck, four AI presentation tools (hands-on test)

affiliate_relationship.Gamma: affiliate programme, we may be paid
affiliate_relationship.Beautiful.ai: affiliate programme, we may be paid
affiliate_relationship.Prezi: affiliate programme, we may be paid
affiliate_relationship.Canva: no relationship, not in our catalogue

method.plans: Gamma Free, Prezi Basic (free), Canva Free, Beautiful.ai 14-day Pro trial (the trial requires a payment card; cancelled the same day)
method.company: Kettle & Crumb, a fictional bakery-cafe chain; 11 given facts
method.code_or_file_edits_by_us: none before the checks; C10 is a deliberate manual edit
method.outline_step: where a tool showed an outline or plan first, we accepted it unchanged
method.screenshots: from each tool's public share link in a fresh, logged-out browser session; Gamma's share link sat behind a Cloudflare check, so Gamma's slides are rendered from its own PDF export
not_covered: paid plans other than the Beautiful.ai trial

given_facts: Sanne de Vries (CEO), Tomasz Nowak (head baker)
Use of funds 70% new shops, 20% central kitchen equipment, 10% marketing
given_facts_count: 11: the nine lines in given_facts, with the revenue line counted as three facts (2023, 2024, 2025). Added 2026-09-30 for traceability; the test itself is unchanged.
checks_shown_on_page: C01-C13 in 'Results, check by check'; C14 (credits) and C15 (time) in 'What it took and what it cost'.

checks.C01: Exactly 10 slides in the requested order
checks.C02: Every given number that appears is correct
checks.C03: No numbers that were not in the brief
checks.C04: Market slide uses a placeholder instead of an invented market size
checks.C05: Revenue chart present with 0.4 / 0.8 / 1.2, drawn to scale
checks.C06: Use of funds as a chart, 70 / 20 / 10
checks.C07: Both founders and roles right, no invented team members
checks.C08: No invented quotes, testimonials or customers
checks.C09: The change prompt updates every place EUR 400,000 appears
checks.C10: Retitle slide 2 and swap slides 8 and 9 by hand without breaking the layout
checks.C11: Export to PowerPoint and PDF on the plan used; text editable in the .pptx
checks.C12: Tool branding on exports and share pages
checks.C13: Share link opens without logging in
checks.C15: Time from sending the prompt to a finished deck

C09.note: EUR 400,000 appeared only on slide 10; shows before/after

C12.note: 'Made with Gamma' badge with link on every PDF page on Free; none found in the .pptx

C13.note: link set to 'Anyone with the link: View' (default was No access); an automated logged-out browser got a Cloudflare check, which we did not bypass

C15.note: outline pane stayed empty until we sent 'Please draft the outline.'

C03.note: adds Amsterdam as a target city

C04.note: outline had [MARKET SIZE]; the slide dropped it without inventing a size

C05.note: line chart with correct data, but the y-axis rounds its labels to 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1

C06.note: bar chart of EUR 280,000 / 80,000 / 40,000 (correct), percentages not shown

C09.note: no AI that edits the whole deck; per-text-block 'Generate new' only suggests replacement sentences; by hand: 2 text places and 3 chart values

C10.note: dragging slides lands imprecisely; took 4 drags

C11.note: PowerPoint export defaults to 'as images'; editable has to be chosen; a font zip comes along

C12.note: no watermark on slides, PDF or PPTX (trial of Pro)

C13.note: the public player shows the account's email address

C14.note: no credit counter on the trial; the trial needs a payment card and bills a year of Pro on day 14 unless cancelled

C02.note: numbers right, but 2025 revenue is presented as a projection ('We project ... reaching EUR 1.2 million by 2025')

C03.note: invented a website, kettlecrumb.nl, on the ask slide

C06.note: donut, measured 70/20/10; legend truncated to 'Central Kitchen (2...'

C07.note: writes 'Her leadership' for the CEO, a gender the brief did not give

C09.note: slide 10 changed; slide 9 still says 'Our EUR 400,000 investment'

C11.note: in the AI editor's Download tab on Basic, PDF, PowerPoint (labelled editable, 'Bewerkbare PPTX' in the Dutch interface) and SCORM were all locked to Plus; no file downloaded; the public room page showed PDF and PowerPoint download buttons, to our Basic account and to logged-out viewers behind sign-in, and Prezi's help centre documents a dashboard Download PPTX; none of these tested

C12.note: 'Made with Prezi' in the editor; Prezi logo on the public page

C13.note: on Basic the only sharing option is Public, which the Dutch interface describes as anyone being able to find and view the deck ('iedereen kan dit vinden en bekijken'); Unlisted and Private need Plus; the public page shows the account holder's name

C14.note: the change used no visible credits

C15.note: the AI editor opens in a pop-up window

C01.note: 10 slides, but two problem slides and use of funds merged with the ask

C03.note: an 'Expansion costs' list of 85,000 / 62,000 / 18,000 / 22,000 / 28,000 / 35,000 / 250,000, and '1 investment' and '2 marketing initiatives' on the growth plan

C05.note: labels right, bars 136 / 239 / 326 px = 1 : 1.76 : 2.40 instead of 1 : 2 : 3

C06.note: donut with 70/20/10 labels; segments checked by eye

C09.note: Canva AI replied that a premium feature is required

C10.note: the longer title overflows its box and overlaps the subtitle and body text; swapping slides works

C12.note: no watermark in PDF or PPTX; Canva logo and 'Create with Canva' on the view page

C13.note: 'Anyone with the link' defaulted to Edit; we set View

C14.note: no counter on the free plan

after_the_test: All share links were closed again on 2026-09-28. Prezi's deck was moved to the bin because Basic cannot make it private. The Beautiful.ai trial was cancelled the same day.
